components.name: Apache NuttX
components.license: Apache-2.0 or compatible; verify individual files
components.notes: NuttX Apps is a separate repository. Check target version, defconfig and Kconfig.

components.name: NuttX Apps
components.license: review per application and bundled third-party content
components.integration: copy/adapt a specific app only after source and license review
components.notes: Keep the apps checkout compatible with the selected NuttX release.

components.name: Zephyr RTOS
components.license: Apache-2.0 (repository metadata; check files and modules)
components.notes: The repo uses a west manifest and external modules; audit the complete module set.

components.name: FreeRTOS Kernel
components.notes: Demo and distribution repositories can include third-party files under separate terms.

components.name: RT-Thread
components.license: Apache-2.0; vendor BSP code may differ
components.notes: Review chip-vendor BSP and package licenses separately.

components.name: CMSIS
components.notes: Use the current CMSIS generation and repository relevant to the target; this entry is an initial discovery pointer.

components.name: libopencm3
components.integration: evaluate license and target coverage before product use
components.notes: Examples and template repositories are separate projects; audit their own content.

components.name: libopencm3 Template
components.notes: Template uses libopencm3 as a submodule.

components.name: PlatformIO Examples
components.license: Apache-2.0 repository metadata; examples may carry additional terms
components.notes: Do not assume all vendor SDKs referenced by examples share the repository license.

components.name: TinyUSB
components.integration: fixed-version dependency plus MCU USB controller DCD/HCD port
components.notes: Check controller support, task/interrupt context, endpoint and buffer constraints.

components.name: lwIP
components.license: BSD-style; verify exact selected release and contrib files
components.integration: porting layer plus netif and OS abstraction
components.notes: Check threading mode, memory pools, socket configuration and vendor patches.

components.name: Nanopb
components.license: verify selected release LICENSE and generated-code terms
components.notes: Pin protoc/plugin/runtime versions together; define maximum message size and schema evolution policy.

components.name: littlefs
components.integration: block-device adapter plus configuration and geometry validation
components.notes: Test power interruption, erase/program constraints and wear behavior on target flash.

components.name: MCUboot
components.integration: bootloader port plus flash layout and signing pipeline
components.notes: Security architecture, key management, rollback and flash layout require product review.

components.name: LVGL
components.license: MIT for LVGL core; LVGL Pro is separately licensed
components.notes: Do not conflate LVGL core with commercial LVGL Pro tools/services.

components.name: Embedded Template Library
components.integration: header-only dependency after C++ standard and configuration review
components.notes: Validate actual container capacity and exception/compiler settings.

components.name: Unity Test Framework
components.notes: Select test runner and target integration based on toolchain.

components.name: Ceedling
components.notes: Requires a Ruby toolchain; pin Ruby gems and compiler versions in CI.
